title: Congressional Research Service UFO study for Carter with Sheehan as special counsel

tellings.quote: he asked the uh Congressional uh Science and Technology committee to to contact the the uh Congressional research service and have them do a special uh research project for him on what all the information was that our United States government had uh about the UFO phenomena

plain: In 1977 President Jimmy Carter is said to have asked for a special study of everything the US government knew about UFOs. Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who says he served as special counsel on the project, tells Michels he took part. In his account the request went through the congressional science and technology committee to the Congressional Research Service, the research arm of Congress at the Library of Congress in Washington. He names a researcher there, Marcia Smith, and tells it as a sign that a president wanted to know what the government held on the subject.
